description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerReviewer class within the OrangeHRM system. The class models a reviewer entity for performance tracking, including properties such as reviewer, associated performance tracker, addition date, and status. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and incorporates a decorator pattern via a trait.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerReviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer for a performance tracker, including relationships to PerformanceTracker and Employee entities, with ORM mapping and decorator support.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer record.

methods.name: getReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee object representing the reviewer.

methods.name: setReviewer
methods.description: Assigns an Employee as the reviewer.

methods.name: setPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Associates a PerformanceTracker with the reviewer.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the reviewer was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the reviewer was added.
